purpose: Bounded pest-model repair experiment, declared before reading 2010-2011 observations
input_contract: Existing 4x9 causal windows, original training-only scaling and target thresholds

training.early_stopping: validation loss, patience 8, restore best weights

selection_before_new_test: Maximize validation macro F1; candidate medium recall must exceed released model and high recall must not fall. If none qualifies, select release. No 2009 or new temporal test used for selection.
comparators: original standardized logistic baseline C=0.1 fit on training only
promotion_gate: No automatic promotion. Require finite contract/reload checks, positive medium recall, nonworse macro F1 and high recall versus release on the new temporal test; disclose all counts, dependence and already-inspected validation history. Missing observations or classes are a coverage gap, not a pass.
no_claim: This is retrospective temporal validation, not a prospective farmer study or a guarantee of model quality.
